name: Frontend
description: A Frontend Developer builds the user-facing part of websites and web applications. They turn UI/UX designs into interactive, responsive, and accessible interfaces, ensuring users can easily view, navigate, and interact with the application across different devices.

name: Backend
description: A Backend Developer builds and maintains the server-side infrastructure of web applications. They handle business logic, databases, security, and system performance, ensuring data is processed and delivered reliably so the frontend can function correctly.

name: Full Stack
description: A full stack developer is a software professional who can build and maintain both the front-end (user-facing, client-side) and back-end (server-side, database) of an application. They oversee the entire development process from concept to deployment.

name: Data Science
description: A Data Scientist analyzes large and complex datasets to uncover insights, identify patterns, and support data-driven decisions. They use statistics, programming, and machine learning to predict trends, solve business problems, and build intelligent data models.

name: DevOps
description: A DevOps developer (often called a DevOps engineer) is an IT professional who bridges the gap between software development (Dev) and IT operations (Ops). They focus on automating workflows, streamlining software delivery, and managing infrastructure to help teams release reliable code much faster. [1, 2]

name: Game Developer
description: A game developer is a software engineer or creative professional who builds video games. They translate a designer? concepts into playable code, handling programming, engine development, and debugging. In smaller teams, they may also take on art, audio, and design. [1, 2, 3]

name: QA
description: A QA (Quality Assurance) tester is a professional who evaluates software and websites to ensure they function correctly and meet all requirements. Their goal is to identify and document bugs, glitches, or usability issues before the product is released to the public, essentially acting as an advocate for the end user.

name: Software Architect
description: A software architect is a senior technical leader who designs the high-level structure of a software system. They create technical blueprints, make strategic decisions about technology stacks, and bridge the gap between business goals and engineering execution to ensure the system is scalable, secure, and maintainable.
